name: CommuteAssistRideshareEta

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short rideshare passenger scene. A person in the back of a taxi or rideshare asks Sigma how long until they arrive. Sigma gives the ETA. Done.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Car interior, rideshare passenger, city driving, evening urban road sounds

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short rideshare scene. The person is a passenger in the back of a taxi or rideshare car. They quietly ask Sigma how long until they arrive. Sigma gives the ETA in minutes. Person reacts with a word or just checks their phone.

variations.context: Passenger in rideshare — quick ETA check

setting.mood: Quiet, passenger in the back, slightly impatient
setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo passenger in a cab or rideshare
setting.background: In the back of a rideshare. Wondering how long. Asks Sigma quietly so as not to bother the driver.
setting.conversation_style: Very quiet. One murmured question. One time answer. Done.

scenario_template.topic: Passenger asks Sigma how long until arrival
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. Spoken quietly. E.g. 'Sigma, how long?' or 'Sigma, ETA?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives arrival time in minutes. Person notes it.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: '12 minutes' or 'You arrive at 19:45'. One sentence. Person: nothing or a quiet 'ok'.

user1.name: Daniela
user1.role: Rideshare passenger. One quiet ETA question. Minimal. Doesn't want to be overheard.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Gives ETA in minutes or as a time. One sentence. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Person is in the back of someone else's car — speaks quietly.
Sigma's answer is a time or number. One sentence.
The whole thing is two lines or fewer.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
ETA in minutes or a clock time. One sentence.
